title: Trove holdings position
description: One line of finance/holdings/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: one investment position at a point in time, keyed by as_of + account + symbol. A dated snapshot appended per sync so a position history accrues. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

as_of.description: RFC3339 local time the snapshot was taken (the brokerage's "as of", else the sync time); date-only sources use local midnight

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

account.description: account this position sits in: a masked number ("...7421") or a name ("Roth IRA") — never the full account number

symbol.description: ticker / asset code as the source gives it (AAPL, VTSAX, BTC, USD for a cash sweep)

name.description: human name of the instrument (Apple Inc, Bitcoin)

quantity.description: units held; fractional for crypto and fractional-share brokerages; for cash, the cash amount

price.description: per-unit market price at as_of (currency is the separate currency field)

value.description: market value of the position at as_of (quantity × price; currency is the separate currency field)

cost_basis.description: total acquisition cost of the position (currency is the separate currency field); omit when the source doesn't report basis

currency.description: currency of price/value/cost_basis; omit when unknown

asset_class.description: instrument type, source vocabulary normalized where clear (equity, etf, fund, crypto, cash, option, bond, future, forex, …; open set)

institution.description: display name of the custodian (Charles Schwab, Coinbase)

extra.description: everything source-specific (account type, lot detail, unrealized gain, day change, …)
